title: Grusch: Oppenheimer helped set up UFO secrecy

tellings.quote: Oppenheimer, somebody purportedly involved in the stand-up of the stuff that I uncovered, right?

plain: The physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer, who led the building of the first atomic bomb in the 1940s, is said to have been involved in setting up the secret UFO work that David Grusch later uncovered. Grusch, a former intelligence officer who went public as a whistleblower, puts it this way: Oppenheimer was "somebody purportedly involved in the stand-up of the stuff that I uncovered." If true, UFO secrecy would date back to the same years and people as the atomic bomb.
